project.description: Mints the PLATFORM API key the frontend's open-access proxy sends with anonymous requests. Each run keeps the key httpd is currently using and revokes older ones. Skipped when the PSAMA release has no api_key table.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# The frontend's open-access proxy (/api/v1/open) sends this PLATFORM key on every # anonymous request. Minted the same way PSAMA's ApiKeyService does, since PSAMA's # minting endpoint needs a SUPER_ADMIN session that init doesn't have.
# This shell runs inside the Jenkins container, where this bind mount is always here. CONFIG_DIR="/usr/local/docker-config" PSAMA_ENV="$CONFIG_DIR/psama/psama.env" HTTPD_ENV="$CONFIG_DIR/httpd/httpd.env" KEY_NAME="AIO frontend open-access proxy"
source /scripts/env-file.sh
mysql_auth() { docker run --rm -i -v "$MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf" --network="${MYSQL_NETWORK:-host}" mysql mysql -N auth "$@" }
require_file "$PSAMA_ENV" require_file "$HTTPD_ENV"
# PSAMA releases before API key support (pic-sure #286) have no api_key table if [ -z "$(mysql_auth -e "SHOW TABLES LIKE 'api_key';")" ]; then echo "This PSAMA release has no api_key table; skipping the platform API key." exit 0 fi
# Keep an existing pepper: changing it would orphan every key already hashed with it pepper="$(read_env API_KEY_PEPPER "$PSAMA_ENV")" if [ -z "$pepper" ]; then pepper="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" upsert_env API_KEY_PEPPER "$pepper" "$PSAMA_ENV" fi
hash_key() { printf '%s' "$1" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$pepper" | awk '{print $NF}' }
# The running httpd keeps its key until Start PIC-SURE recreates it, so that key stays # valid until the next run. The pipeline rewrites httpd.env first, keeping the old copy # in httpd.env.bak. in_use_key="$(read_env PICSURE_PLATFORM_API_KEY "$HTTPD_ENV")" if [ -z "$in_use_key" ] && [ -f "$HTTPD_ENV.bak" ]; then in_use_key="$(read_env PICSURE_PLATFORM_API_KEY "$HTTPD_ENV.bak")" fi in_use_hash="" if [ -n "$in_use_key" ]; then in_use_hash="$(hash_key "$in_use_key")" fi
# picsure_p_ + 43 base62 chars + 6-char base62 CRC32 of the prefix and body. # A gzip stream ends with the little-endian CRC32 of its input. base62=0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz body="$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' < /dev/urandom | head -c 43 || true)" prefixed="picsure_p_$body" crc="$(printf '%s' "$prefixed" | gzip -c | tail -c 8 | head -c 4 | od -An -tu4 --endian=little | tr -d ' ')" checksum="" for _ in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do checksum="${base62:$((crc % 62)):1}$checksum" crc=$((crc / 62)) done api_key="$prefixed$checksum" key_hash="$(hash_key "$api_key")"
# Never expires: only this job rotates the key, so an expiry would silently break # anonymous access on a stack that isn't re-initialized in time mysql_auth <<SQL INSERT INTO api_key (uuid, key_hash, hash_scheme, display_prefix, key_type, name, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(UUID()), '$key_hash', 'HMAC_SHA256', '${body:0:8}', 'PLATFORM', '$KEY_NAME', UTC_TIMESTAMP()); SQL upsert_env PICSURE_PLATFORM_API_KEY "$api_key" "$HTTPD_ENV"
mysql_auth <<SQL UPDATE api_key SET revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE name = '$KEY_NAME' AND key_type = 'PLATFORM' AND revoked_at IS NULL AND key_hash NOT IN ('$key_hash', '$in_use_hash'); SQL
echo "Minted platform API key ${body:0:8} -- recreate psama and httpd (Start PIC-SURE) to apply."
